text: 中资券商“出海”正从零星试探转向集中加码，年内境外子公司增资规模已突破500亿元，中东、中亚等地区成为新的战略支点。近期，中资券商国际化布局动作频频。国联民生证券20亿元增资香港子公司正式获中国证监会无异议复函，中信建投国际拿下迪拜国际金融中心（DIFC）牌照，国泰君安国际与哈萨克斯坦阿拉木图市政府签署合作备忘录——一系列动作标志着券商全球化布局正从香港枢纽向中东、中亚纵深延伸。（上证报）
text_en: Chinese securities firms' 'going global' is shifting from scattered exploration to concentrated expansion, with capital increases to overseas subsidiaries already exceeding 50 billion yuan this year, and the Middle East and Central Asia becoming new strategic pivots. Recently, Chinese securities firms have made frequent moves in international expansion. Guolian Minsheng Securities' 2 billion yuan capital increase for its Hong Kong subsidiary officially received a no-objection reply letter from the CSRC, China Securities International obtained a Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC) license, and Guotai Junan International signed a memorandum of cooperation with the Almaty city government in Kazakhstan - a series of moves marking that securities firms' global layout is extending from the Hong Kong hub deeper into the Middle East and Central Asia. (Shanghai Securities News)
